name: Lucien
desc:
Lucien is a Felinor NPC. He is a miner working in the [Songseeker Wilds](location:songseeker_wilds).

Lucien teaches the player the recipe to crafting Iron Bombs through the Quest "Mineskipper Mayhem".

His helmet is an heirloom from [Meemaw](entity:lucien), who also survived Mineskippers with the same helmet.
